# AI Agent Scale Down! Kuailu Technology was invited to the Fukuda “Link” Sharon Round Table Discussion

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Published: 2025-12-26
- Original link: [https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202512/26/WS694e4795a310942cc4998cd8.html](https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202512/26/WS694e4795a310942cc4998cd8.html]

## Text
Recently, the “Link AI Founding Sharon II” was successfully organized at the Shenzhen International Innovation Centre and Kuailu Technology was invited to participate in the round table. The event was directed by the Fukuda Institute of Science, Technology and Industrial Information, the Office of Artificial Intelligence Industries of Fukuda Region, hosted by Fukuda Industrial Investment Services Ltd. in Shenzhen City, supported by Shenzhen Fukui Innovation Development Co. Ltd., and co-sponsored by the Fukuda District Investment Promotion Agency, and co-sponsored by the Shenzhen City Association of Artificial Intelligence Industries, which attracted more than 50 business representatives in the areas of finance, technology, commerce and trade.

At the event, guests from deep-earth artificial intelligence, Tianhai light technology, smart and soft technology, and the Chinese commercial Heistin (Fukuda) joint law firm shared the industry ' s practical understanding and use of AI Agent. Subsequently, guests such as Sun Wan Rue, Deputy Secretary-General of the Society of Artificial Intelligence Industries of Shenzhen City, Zhang Xue, Executive Director of Quanzheng Capital, CEO Mo Ji-sail of Shenzhen City, CTO Sun-sook of the Shenzhen Network Technology Company, and General Vice-President of Kuailu Technology Limited of Shenzhen City, and Doo Shenzhen Solutions Architect of Shenzhen, Shanghai-Hashioka-Hashimook-Hashioka, conducted a round-table discussion on the theme “Ecoco-Creative Cogeneration — AAI Agent Application Ecology for Prosperity” to deepen the dialogue on the core issues of technology synergy, capital endowment and ecological co-building. The discussion further brought together the industry consensus that led to the scaling-down of AI Agent and injected synergy into Shenzhen to create an AI high ground of global impact.

In response to “how customization projects settle into standardized products”, Njig shared his practical experience with Kuailu Technology: “Kuailu Technology builds in depth and refines the complex business logic and application scenes. We first `discover commonality' and dismantle the high frequency demand scenes in the project, such as core requirements such as conference hosting; and then `functionalize', encapsulating complex needs as standard modules plus advanced functional modules to achieve 80 per cent of configured delivery, such as hosting environments that both support real person image hosting and customize digital images to accommodate standardized efficiency and personalized needs.”

Turning to the commercialization path of Kuailu Technology, Njig identified the core strategy: “The key to commercialization is three: first, to focus office coordination to break down the tracks, not to do redundant large- and product-wide, but to further diversify market demand and improve product flexibility; secondly, to upgrade delivery models, to reduce delivery cycles from monthly to weekly through technological innovation, and to significantly increase client responsiveness; and thirdly, to tighten the four elements of product design — customer needs, core pain points, competitive advantages, customer experience — each step seeks to be extremely competitive.”

At present, artificial intelligence is accelerating its evolution towards autonomous decision-making and task implementation, and AI Agent intelligence has become a central tool for business efficiency and the re-engineering of work processes. In the future, Kuailu Technology will continue to focus on the area of co-location, with technological innovation at its core, deepening standardized product deposition and delivery models to optimize, and actively engaging industry partners to build AI Agent ecology.
